Overall RAG System.query: Summarize the full payment schedule for laying On Shore pipelines (Free issue).
Overall RAG System.answer: 5% on site development/ROU grading; 10% trenching; 5% stringing; 15% fabrication/welding; 5% radiography/NDT; 5% joint coating; 10% lowering/laying HDPE duct; 5% tie-ins; 10% backfilling; 10% hydro testing; 5% dewatering/pigging; 10% restoration; 5% on completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: Outline the three different payment structures for Structural Steel Works based on the source of the materials.
Overall RAG System.answer: 1. Contractor-supplied: 5% on drawings, 55% on receipt, 20% on fabrication, 15% on erection, 5% completion. 2. At issue rates (chargeable): 5% drawings, 75% transportation/fabrication, 15% erection, 5% completion. 3. Free Issue: 5% drawings, 50% transportation/fabrication, 40% erection, 5% completion

Overall RAG System.query: What are the payment steps for the installation of an SPM & PLEM System for a submarine pipeline?
Overall RAG System.answer: 5% pre-construction survey; 20% mobilization of Lay-barge/equipment; 10% receiving/taking over SPM & PLEM; 55% installation and testing; 5% As-Built drawings; 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: Describe the payment schedule for the supply and erection of contractor-supplied Piping Works fabricated at a yard outside the project premises.
Overall RAG System.answer: 50% on receipt at yard (against BG); 20% on fabrication/NDT and receipt at site; 15% site erection/welding; 5% supports/vents/drains; 3% flushing/testing; 2% mechanical completion; 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: What are the conditions that must be met to consider a minimum continuous stretch for the 10% payment of lowering and laying HDPE ducts on-shore?
Overall RAG System.answer: A minimum continuous stretch of 10 KMs or 5% of spread length (whichever is lower) must be considered, except for discontinuities at listed crossings. This does not apply in city areas or where continuous ROU is not released

Overall RAG System.query: Outline the payment steps for contractor-supplied open tank floating roofs (Design and plate work).
Overall RAG System.answer: 5% design approval; 40% receipt at site; 10% fabrication; 15% erection; 20% welding/NDT; 5% testing; 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: Summarize the breakdown of payments for HDD works.
Overall RAG System.answer: 10% Geotechnical Survey/design; 25% string preparation/NDT/pre-testing/coating; 10% pilot hole drilling; 35% reaming/pulling; 10% post-testing/tie-in/backfilling; 5% restoration/NOC; 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: What are the steps and payment percentages for the erection of Heavy lift equipment (Column, Vessels, etc.) on a lump-sum basis?
Overall RAG System.answer: 20% on mobilization of required crane; 45% transportation to site and erection on foundation; 25% alignment/grouting; 3% cleaning/box up; 2% mechanical completion; 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: Outline the payment schedule for the Temporary & Permanent Cathodic Protection works.
Overall RAG System.answer: 5% design approval; 5% issuance of sub-order (against BG); 40% receipt at site; 20% progressive installation; 25% testing and commissioning (including post-commissioning survey and mitigation); 5% completion certificate

Overall RAG System.query: Summarize the proposal details and requirements for the PRS deferment.
Overall RAG System.answer: It proposes the deferment of price adjustment beyond the contractual completion date without the submission of a BG, for billing up to 80% of the nominal contract value of the WP-14 package, provided the PMC ensures sufficient funds and the agency furnishes fortnightly utilization reports
